releaseNotes.en: Preview checklist: LepTraits and the NHM HOSTS archive supply exact-match wingspan, habitat-affinity, phenology or host-plant facts for part of the list. Visual identification traits remain unverified and regional phenology coverage is sparse; absent fields mean no verified species-level source. Some plates are archetypes while rights review continues.

sources: GBIF occurrence species facets and Backbone taxonomy (api.gbif.org)
iNaturalist Thailand research-grade observation species counts (api.inaturalist.org)
Spidex merged candidate checklist; geographic occurrence and field accounts not expert-vetted
LepTraits 1.0 species trait data (Shirey et al. 2022; CC0)
HOSTS Lepidopteran hostplants archive (Natural History Museum 2023; CC0)
